name: viewer_own
label: Column 1 — the reader's own account
help_text: Set in small capitals. The drawing's geometry is fixed: renaming a column changes the word, not the picture. Keep it under about 28 characters or it will run into the next column.

name: viewer_same_org
label: Column 2 — another account in the same organization

name: viewer_other_org
label: Column 3 — an account in a different organization
help_text: Under about 28 characters. This column is drawn as an empty outline on purpose.

name: caption
label: Caption
default: Rows another account cannot see were never returned to it. Nothing is greyed out, because there was nothing to withhold. Another organization gets no record at all.
help_text: The sentence under the drawing. Leave it empty to hide it. This is real type rather than a hint, so it should say what the picture means.
